headword: {違法駐車|いほうちゅうしゃ}

definitions.explanation: Parking a vehicle in a location or manner that violates traffic laws. A common urban issue in Japan where street parking is heavily regulated.

examples.japanese: {違法駐車|いほうちゅうしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{罰金|ばっきん}→罰金：18767_bakkin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}られた→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I was fined for illegal parking.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{違法駐車|いほうちゅうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There is a lot of illegal parking on this street.

examples.japanese: {違法駐車|いほうちゅうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取|と}り{締|し}まり→取り締まり：07445_torishimari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厳|きび}しく→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}く→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ようになった。
examples.english: Thanks to stricter enforcement against illegal parking, the roads have become easier to use.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{違法|いほう}→違法：09687_ihou⟧ (illegal, unlawful) and ⟦{駐車|ちゅうしゃ}→駐車：01466_chuusha⟧ (parking). In Japan, street parking regulations are strict, and since 2006, private enforcement officers ({駐車監視員|ちゅうしゃかんしいん}) have been deployed to issue tickets for illegal parking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {違法駐車|いほうちゅうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取|と}り{締|し}まり→取り締まり：07445_torishimari⟧: crackdown on illegal parking
- {違法駐車|いほうちゅうしゃ}{禁止|きんし}: no illegal parking (on signs)
- {違法駐車|いほうちゅうしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{罰金|ばっきん}→罰金：18767_bakkin⟧: fined for illegal parking
- {違法駐車|いほうちゅうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通報|つうほう}→通報：14318_tsuuhou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to report illegal parking

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{路上駐車|ろじょうちゅうしゃ}→路上駐車：24063_rojouchuusha⟧: street parking — parking on the road (may or may not be illegal)
- ⟦{駐車違反|ちゅうしゃいはん}→駐車違反：21077_chuushaihan⟧: parking violation — essentially the same meaning, more commonly heard in everyday speech
- {迷惑駐車|めいわくちゅうしゃ}: nuisance parking — parking that causes inconvenience, not necessarily illegal
